en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning: The root دَهَمَ (dahama) denotes coming upon a thing suddenly in darkness. Ibn Fāris gives its core as غشيان الشيء في ظلام; from it come أدهم, deep black, and the sense of a calamity descending unexpectedly.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
